integrity.evidence: Reproducible complete finite enumeration, algebraic reliability polynomial, and exact witness matching test; no extrapolation or independent certification.
integrity.proof_boundaries: Exhaustive for all guild splits at total sizes two through eight; 32 exact survivor states per nine-vertex witness.

scientific_limitations: Finite connectivity/reliability theorem: all connected degree-matched undirected bipartite networks with at most eight total vertices, and an explicit nonunique nine-vertex witness. Independent homogeneous pollinator losses; plants remain without secondary extinctions. No claims about larger-order classification, ecological dynamics, or correlated failure. Related full text inaccessible; an equivalent older small-graph result cannot be excluded.
title: A sharp nine-species crossover in degree-matched ecological connectivity
